profile.name: Diar F.
profile.headline: I build networks and IT systems that keep working.
profile.intro: Routers, Wi-Fi, VPNs, Microsoft 365, servers and backups — set up properly, documented, and easy to live with. Based in Kosovo, working with clients anywhere.

services.name: Network setup
services.what: Router, firewall and Wi-Fi for a home or office, with separate networks for staff, guests and devices.

services.name: VPN and remote access
services.what: Secure access to your office from anywhere — per-user accounts and a simple guide for each person.

services.name: Microsoft 365 and email
services.what: Email on your own domain, Teams and OneDrive, mailbox migration and sign-in security.

services.name: Servers and backup
services.what: Virtual servers on Proxmox or Hyper-V, and automatic backups with a tested restore.

services.name: Custom tools
services.what: Small web tools, dashboards and Windows apps built around how you actually work.

services.name: Remote support
services.what: Something broken or slow? One-off fixes, or a monthly plan for small teams.
